title: Your prices

mode.platform_rate_card: You are on Packio's rate card — review and answer each new version Packio sends.
mode.factory_price_list: You keep your own price list — propose changes; Packio reviews them before they apply.

attention.title: Waiting for your answer
attention.rateCardBody: {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} to answer · applies from {date}
attention.counteredBody: Take or withdraw {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}}
attention.signOffBody: Version {version} · {lines} lines · applies from {date} once you sign it off

lists.title: Price lists by product type
lists.quoteOnly: Quote on request — no price list

readOnly: Your role can view prices; the owner proposes or accepts them.

tierC.title: Quote on request
tierC.body: There is no price table for this type yet; Packio asks you for a price job by job. Giving prices up front means:
tierC.unlockInstant: customers get an instant price on the web, without waiting for a quote
tierC.unlockJobs: you receive more jobs, more steadily
tierC.unlockRfq: no more pricing each job one by one

tierRequest.title: Ask for a higher tier
tierRequest.bodyC: Send the Partner team a request; they will set up your price table with you.
tierRequest.bodyB: Tier A means prices for every spec, so every configuration is quoted instantly.
tierRequest.placeholder: E.g. we can now price every size and material

tiers.A: Full price list — instant quotes and automatic job allocation
tiers.B: Prices for some specs, such as standard sizes — instant quotes there, quote requests outside
tiers.C: Quote on request — no price table; Packio asks you for a price job by job

origin.platform_rate_card: Packio's rate card, accepted by you

noVersionBody: Start by proposing your first prices below

propose.title: Propose new prices
propose.body: New prices apply to new orders from the date you choose; orders already priced keep theirs.

rateCardMode.title: Packio's rate card
rateCardMode.body: Packio updates this table; when a new version comes, you are asked to review and answer it.

signOff.title: Sign off the prices
signOff.body: You confirm that {label} entered by Packio for you are right. They apply to new orders from their planned date.

create.fromFuture: The date must be after today
create.reasonRequired: Give a reason of at least 3 characters
create.fromHint: Never back-dated; Packio approves it before then
create.reasonHint: E.g. paper prices rise next month

submit.noLines: Add at least one line first
submit.title: Send the proposal
submit.body: Send the {type} proposal ({count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}}) to the Partner team. Lines cannot change after sending; you can withdraw it.

withdraw.title: Withdraw the proposal
withdraw.body: Withdraw the {type} proposal. Prices in force do not change.

evidence.rules: PDF, JPG or PNG, up to 20 MB
evidence.wrongType: {name} is not a PDF, JPG or PNG

rateCard.ownerOnly: The factory owner answers rate cards.
rateCard.counterUnchanged: {line}: the counter does not change anything
rateCard.sent: {count, plural, one {# answer} other {# answers}} sent
rateCard.allBody: Accept all {count} lines as Packio proposed them.
rateCard.acceptAllBody: You accept all {count} {type} lines. They apply to new orders from their date, and Packio keeps your acceptance as evidence.

shipping.title: What Packio pays for delivery
shipping.body: When you deliver with your own fleet, Packio pays this table (VAT excluded).
shipping.ownerOnly: The factory owner answers rate cards.
shipping.amountInvalid: {band}: enter an amount such as 45 or 45.50
shipping.sent: {count, plural, one {# answer} other {# answers}} sent
shipping.acceptAllBody: You accept the {count} lines awaiting an answer.
shipping.openBody: Applies from {date} · {count} lines not yet agreed
shipping.noCurrent: No delivery rates in force yet

editor.unreadable: Could not read {name}; use an .xlsx or .csv file
editor.noLines: No lines yet; add one below or upload a sheet
editor.sheetTitle: Change many lines with a sheet
editor.sheetBody: Download your current prices, edit them in Excel and upload the file; check the preview first. The sheet replaces every line of the draft.

problems.bad_action: Row {row}: {column} must be add, change or remove
problems.not_integer: Row {row}: {column} must be a whole number
problems.not_boolean: Row {row}: {column} must be true or false

editor.sheetUsed: {count, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}} taken from the sheet

proposal.draftBody: Add, change or remove lines, then send it to Packio.
proposal.sendBody: The Packio Partner team checks each line and may accept, reject or counter it.
proposal.countersBody: Take the counter or withdraw that line; other lines stay as decided.
proposal.answerBody: It applies to new orders from {date}, once every line is agreed.
proposal.evidenceBody: E.g. a mill's price letter or a supplier invoice
